papers.title: A Fast Algorithm for Quaternion Tensor Singular Value Decomposition under the T-product
authors: Daochang Zhang, Yue Zhao, Jingqian Li
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.31451v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Quaternion tensor singular value decomposition (T-SVD) under the T-product provides a framework for analyzing multidimensional quaternion data. However, the T-SVD construction of Pan and Ng (SIAM J. Matrix Anal. Appl., 2024) \cite{PanNg2024} contains a structural gap: an unrestricted quaternion matrix SVD need not preserve the paired Fourier block structure required for tensor factor recovery, potentially leading to loss of T-unitarity and inaccurate reconstruction.

papers.title: Phase Transition from Random Features to Fully Trainable Networks
authors: Xin He, Huan Lao, Xiliang Lu, Shijun Zhang
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.31663v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Constructing accurate and computationally tractable approximation spaces is a fundamental task in scientific computing. Partially trainable neural networks bridge fixed random features and fully adaptive representations. This paper quantifies a phase transition pattern in approximation bounds and observes analogous behavior in training errors: a rapid but smooth initial improvement followed by diminishing returns, with a sharper transition under greater initialization mismatch.
